scope: Static source review of all registered apps; not a live-provider certification

apps.label: System Settings
apps.mechanism: Local preferences, feature gates, themes and optional wallpaper adapters
apps.limitations: Browser-stored client keys and backups are not a secret vault; provider keys belong on a backend.

apps.label: About AetherOS
apps.mechanism: Registry-derived app guide, measured browser capabilities and Git/GitHub commit history
apps.limitations: Build metadata is a snapshot; GitHub history may be cached or unavailable. No invented hardware or performance guarantees.

apps.label: Terminal
apps.mechanism: JavaScript command dispatcher operating on the browser VFS
apps.limitations: JavaScript command console, not a Unix shell. The ping command is an HTTP timing probe, not ICMP or a reachability guarantee. Cannot execute host commands or inspect OS processes.

apps.label: Files
apps.mechanism: IndexedDB files, uploads, previews and Wikipedia imports
apps.limitations: Browser storage may be denied or evicted; saves await transaction results and disclose session-only fallback. Nested file paths and custom empty folders are mounted from stored data. No host filesystem access, trash, undo deletion, or recursive folder deletion.

apps.label: WikiBoard
apps.mechanism: WikiBoardEngine DOM/SVG research canvas, validated HTTP(S)/YouTube additions and editable v2 JSON board export
apps.limitations: Browser storage is not a backup; failed saves are reported. Remote card content may be blocked and imported board content should be trusted.

apps.label: Web Browser
apps.mechanism: Iframe navigation plus a reader/clipper
apps.limitations: Reader/embed workspace, not a complete browser. HTTP(S) URLs only; per-tab navigation works within the reader. Public relays require per-URL consent and can see the full URL. Third-party embeds may be blocked. External favicon services may receive domains.

apps.label: Music & Podcasts
apps.mechanism: Music-theater player adapters, podcast/audio playback, LRCLIB and Last.fm metadata
apps.limitations: External presence is not a playback clock. Missing lyrics do not imply an instrumental track. Legacy visual meter is not an FFT.

apps.label: Stickers & Profiles
apps.mechanism: Manual StickersAPI media search with licensed-source links and fallbacks
apps.limitations: CDN failures and content moderation depend on providers; automatic reaction matching is heuristic.

apps.label: World Radio
apps.mechanism: Radio Browser directory, latest-search-wins filtering, browser favorites/export and validated HTTP(S) audio streams
apps.limitations: Unknown bitrates remain unknown. Stream URLs may be blocked, unavailable or insecure. Browser storage failures are reported; a flat visualizer means audio analysis is unavailable, not simulated audio.

apps.label: Weather
apps.mechanism: Explicit city match selection or permission-based device coordinates; Open-Meteo forecast/AQI with local-time hourly/daily views, units, timeout/cancellation and labelled cached fallback
apps.limitations: Live provider access not verified in this sandbox. Forecast models are not local sensors or severe-weather alerts. Optional AQI may be unavailable; cached refresh failures are labelled. Selected coordinates are browser-stored and shared with Open-Meteo on requests. No silent IP lookup/default local city.

apps.label: News & RSS
apps.mechanism: Curated HN/DEV/GitHub/Reddit API reading room with per-source cached/error states, safe plain-text reader, tab-session read filters, validated saved links/export and awaited visible-text clipping
apps.limitations: Not a general RSS subscription client. Source APIs may be blocked, rate-limited or unavailable; live access not verified here. DEV preview is bounded plain Markdown; HN is a partial discussion, other sources summaries. Saved links are not offline articles; browser storage can fail. Shared shell digest scheduling remains active when enabled.

apps.label: Activity & Speed
apps.mechanism: requestAnimationFrame deltas, optional JS heap/storage/battery APIs and network speed requests
apps.limitations: Measures this page, not host CPU/RAM. Missing metrics must remain unavailable; speed tests transfer data.

apps.label: Task Manager
apps.mechanism: Native window inventory with confirmed close/focus actions, bounded measured browser-page heap/DOM/timer-delay history, pause/resume and JSON report export
apps.limitations: Not an OS process manager: no per-app CPU or RAM, and window close is not a device process kill. Heap is an optional browser estimate; callback delay includes timer scheduling/throttling effects. Session-only history, skipped while hidden or paused. Export includes open window titles.

apps.label: Focus & Soundscapes
apps.mechanism: Pomodoro/session state and generated WebAudio soundscapes
apps.limitations: Timer uses wall-clock deadlines while this page is running; closing/reloading ends the timer. Noise and two-tone pads are synthesized locally, not recordings or validated health interventions. Browser storage may be unavailable.

apps.label: Dev Studio
apps.mechanism: Markdown editor and JSON/Base64/JWT/regex/SHA tools
apps.limitations: JWT decoding does not verify signatures. Regex runs in a worker with a 750 ms timeout and bounded input/output. Markdown is a limited renderer. Browser storage is not a backup; export important documents.

apps.label: Kanban Board
apps.mechanism: Saved boards/cards, priorities, drag-and-drop and export
apps.limitations: Local single-browser board, not multi-user collaboration. Edits, moves and one-level deletion undo are supported; use Markdown export as a backup. Storage errors leave data session-only.

apps.label: Photo Booth
apps.mechanism: Opt-in video capture, local image import, nine canvas effects, cancellable countdown/strips, session gallery, PNG download and awaited Files saves
apps.limitations: Camera requires permission and a secure context; physical webcam not certified. Clearly labelled procedural demo is not camera input. Creative filters are not thermal or medical imaging. Last 12 captures are session-only until downloaded or durably saved; import is limited to 10 MiB/16 MP (pixel check after decoding). Close invalidates requests and stops camera tracks.

apps.label: SynthPad Studio
apps.mechanism: Local Web Audio one-shot instruments, live output waveform, editable 16-step drum grid, look-ahead audio clock, master gain, validated pattern save/import/export
apps.limitations: Synthesised tones/noise, not sampled instruments or a DAW. Starts with an empty pattern; named grooves are examples. Patterns are session-only until saved in browser or exported as JSON, not audio. No recording, MIDI or held-note envelopes. Playback stops on close or hidden tab; browser audio and background policies apply. Headless output verified, not real-device listening/latency certification.

apps.label: Photopea Studio
apps.mechanism: Explicit Photopea connection, ready-message-gated canvas presets and bounded local-file bridge, requested PNG/WebP export, awaited Files save and retained download
apps.limitations: Third-party editor, not native; opened files are shared with its iframe. Live provider availability unverified. Exact source/origin checks and 25 MiB limits apply. Raster exports do not preserve layers; use provider PSD save. Timeout disables bridge until reload. External links do not transfer unsaved editor state.

apps.label: Whiteboard Studio
apps.mechanism: Explicit visual selection of Excalidraw, diagrams.net or tldraw; diagrams.net ready handshake, validated editable XML import/download and awaited Files saving
apps.limitations: Third-party embeds with their own privacy/storage/framing policies; no live provider certification. Excalidraw/tldraw use provider save/export controls. Only diagrams.net XML is bridged (2 MiB, no DTD/entities). Diagrams remain session-only unless saved/downloaded. Switching/reload may lose provider work. External links do not transfer unsaved state.

apps.label: Retro & 3D Makers
apps.mechanism: BeepBox, Blockbench and JSPaint external studios
apps.limitations: Third-party tools; availability, storage and export formats are controlled by each service.

apps.label: World Museum Gallery
apps.mechanism: Three included real public-domain reproductions, optional Art Institute online search, pinned IIIF images/retries, zoom viewer, 50-reference collection, link export and awaited reference saving
apps.limitations: Online API may be unreachable (Failed to fetch); included local works remain usable and are never labelled live search results. Included reproductions are browsing-size, not archival downloads; attribution in assets/museum/SOURCES.md. Collection exports/Files saves contain references, not artwork binaries. Empty valid searches remain empty. Live metadata was checked; full remote image availability is unverified.

apps.label: Open Bookshelf
apps.mechanism: Gutendex catalog with real Gutenberg covers/pagination, direct bounded Gutenberg text, local TXT reading, typography/themes, progress positions and text export
apps.limitations: Live provider/CORS access not verified here. Direct text can be blocked; no public relays used. 2 MiB text limit is explicit, never silently truncated. Text remains in this tab; saved positions are browser storage, not book backups. Copyright and availability vary by jurisdiction; download counts are not reads.

apps.label: Earth Monitor
apps.mechanism: USGS earthquake and NASA EONET observations, responsive coordinate map, event selection, JSON observation export and optional Windy embed
apps.limitations: No invented fallback events or hazard magnitudes. Failed requests clear observations; provider tsunami flags are not official warnings. Not an emergency alert service.

apps.label: Space Launches
apps.mechanism: Launch Library 2 upcoming schedule and in-space crew, selected-mission imagery and NET estimate, local/UTC times, static ICS calendar export, optional real-coordinate Atlas handoff
apps.limitations: First 20 provider records per feed, not a complete mission/crew inventory. No fabricated fallback launch or crew. NET is an estimate, not liftoff confirmation; past times say verify status. Refresh failures mark retained real records stale. Calendar files do not update automatically. Live provider availability not certified.

apps.label: 3D Solar System & Sky
apps.mechanism: NASA Eyes and Stellarium web embeds
apps.limitations: Remote simulations/visualizations, not measurements made by AetherOS.

apps.label: Atlas & Landmarks
apps.mechanism: OSM map embeds and geotagged Wikipedia articles
apps.limitations: Nearby article matches do not guarantee tourist access or precise physical location.

apps.label: World Factbook & FX
apps.mechanism: REST Countries reference browser, World Bank GDP chart with selection-race protection, dated Frankfurter FX and JSON country export
apps.limitations: Country and GDP indicators have different reporting dates. Country failures do not substitute sample statistics. FX dates are provider publication dates, not tick-level prices.

apps.label: Archive & DOS Vault
apps.mechanism: Archive.org search and DOS embeds plus confirmed closest-snapshot Wayback lookup with actual archive dates
apps.limitations: No navigation is invented when lookup fails or has no snapshot. Archive media is not automatically public domain. Provider framing, sign-in and availability remain outside this client.

apps.label: Winamp + SomaFM
apps.mechanism: Webamp/SomaFM deck with provider metadata, curated station fallback, stream mirrors and JSON directory export
apps.limitations: Curated station names are not proof that streams work. Unknown listener counts/tracks are labelled unknown; Radio Browser votes are not listeners. Webamp is a third-party player.

apps.label: GitHub Explorer
apps.mechanism: Live unauthenticated GitHub repository search and encoded Contents API directory/UTF-8 source browsing with ref selection, bounded previews and clipboard actions
apps.limitations: Public read-only repos only; unauthenticated GitHub rate limits and directory limits apply. No fake fallback statistics. Binary/non-UTF-8 or >256 KiB sources are not previewed. No Markdown execution/rendering or write operations.

apps.label: Shader Studio
apps.mechanism: Local WebGL GLSL ES 1.00 workbench, four built-in scenes, explicit compile with preserved last-good output, time/pointer uniforms, bounded preview buffers, draft/import/export, PNG capture and awaited Files save
apps.limitations: Single fragment pass only; no textures, buffers or sound compatibility. Trusted GLSL only: expensive shaders can freeze the GPU/tab; Pause is not isolation. Drafts/imports never auto-run. PNG is preview resolution, not source or guaranteed HD. Optional Shadertoy player needs network/framing permission; no live readiness guarantee. Headless WebGL verified, not physical-device GPU certification.

apps.label: Code Sandbox
apps.mechanism: Local HTML/CSS/JS editor with explicit-run opaque-origin sandbox, restrictive preview CSP, captured console, validated editable project import/export and browser draft storage
apps.limitations: Only run trusted code: synchronous loops can freeze the tab; Stop is not a CPU interrupt. Preview CSP restricts resource requests, not a network firewall; self-navigation can replace preview. Exported HTML runs without preview restrictions. Drafts are browser storage, not backups; Files may be session-only.

apps.label: Device Sync
apps.mechanism: WebRTC device/folder sharing through AetherBridge service
apps.limitations: Requires signaling/peers; DTLS transport is not proof of peer identity or an authenticated filesystem.

apps.label: AetherLink P2P
apps.mechanism: WebRTC data channels for rooms, chat and transfers
apps.limitations: STUN/signaling may fail behind NAT without TURN; room codes are not a complete authentication system.

apps.label: Discord Presence
apps.mechanism: Lanyard public Discord presence and optional webhook requests
apps.limitations: Presence requires Lanyard participation. Webhook URLs are credentials; do not expose them in shared backups.

apps.label: ISS 3D Tracker
apps.mechanism: WhereTheISS observed position and provider trajectory on a procedural Three.js globe, visible feed timestamps/unavailable states
apps.limitations: Globe textures/stars and broad region labels are illustrative. Missing provider trajectories are cleared, never replaced by invented orbital predictions. Not a precision propagator.

apps.label: NASA Space
apps.mechanism: NASA APOD, EPIC, Mars and solar-weather viewers with latest-tab-wins rendering and source imagery
apps.limitations: DEMO_KEY limits, provider failures and image availability apply. Retrying a failed category keeps that category. Third-party media may restrict embedding.

apps.label: Flight Radar
apps.mechanism: ADS-B provider flights drawn on a geographic viewport
apps.limitations: Not navigation/safety equipment; provider coverage, latency and rate limits apply. Network errors must not synthesize aircraft.

apps.label: Crypto Markets
apps.mechanism: Binance Vision historical OHLC and WebSocket candles with Kraken historical fallback, symbol/interval race protection and JSON candle export
apps.limitations: History and quotes may be delayed or unavailable. Switching symbols clears previous candles. Not executable quotes or investment advice; different provider quote currencies can differ.

apps.label: Arcade
apps.mechanism: External web-game embeds
apps.limitations: Browser framing, input and availability vary; not locally implemented games.

apps.label: Retro TV
apps.mechanism: Curated video channels and YouTube embeds
apps.limitations: Curated playlists are not live television; no playback clock without a player adapter.

apps.label: Reddit Gallery
apps.mechanism: Reddit image feeds and lightbox
apps.limitations: Reddit can block anonymous browser requests; source content moderation/licensing varies.

apps.label: Anime
apps.mechanism: Jikan/MyAnimeList discovery with latest-query-wins search/details and explicit result selection, trailers and source links
apps.limitations: Metadata does not grant streaming rights. Provider limits, trailers and source links may be unavailable. No first-result auto-navigation on a new search.

apps.label: Manga Reader
apps.mechanism: Jikan discovery with latest-query-wins search/details, browser reading-list export and MangaDex chapter data
apps.limitations: Chapters depend on language, region and provider availability. No promise of licensed access to every title. Reading list is stored in this browser.

apps.label: Character Dex
apps.mechanism: Character API metadata and a local randomized battle mini-game
apps.limitations: Battle damage and outcomes are game mechanics, not canon power rankings or live measurements.

apps.label: Floor796 Panorama
apps.mechanism: Floor796 external panorama/mirror viewer
apps.limitations: Artwork and updates belong to Floor796; mirrors may lag or block framing.

apps.label: Wplace World Canvas
apps.mechanism: External collaborative canvas viewer
apps.limitations: No local implementation of the global canvas or guarantee of write access; provider controls sign-in/availability.
